title: ASC 995 — U.S. Steamship Entities
summary: Addresses Capital Construction Fund deferred tax treatment for U.S. steamship entities under the Merchant Marine Act.
description: ASC 995 covers the Capital Construction Fund created under Merchant Marine Act Section 607 and the associated deferred tax exception for CCF deposits. It is a genuinely US-specific maritime tax construct with no direct IFRS equivalent.

bannerNotice.title: No Direct IFRS Equivalent
bannerNotice.body: No direct IFRS equivalent exists. ASC 995 addresses a uniquely US maritime tax construct under the Merchant Marine Act that has no parallel in IFRS.
